review_scope: Read-only independent review of the fit admission generator and its embedded remote gate. This review does not run admission, SSH, data loading, or training.
reviewed_gates: Requires the accepted seed-3 profile evidence and verifies the profile launch and log hashes before constructing the remote payload.
Reuses only the reviewed profile admission helper definitions, binds the accepted source commit and 164-file source manifest, and requires clean destinations and an unused exact fit unit.

Checks the current canonical fold-0 split as a regular non-symlink file, hashes its bytes against the fixed recipe SHA, checks stable before/after stat identity, and records the split identity before creating outputs or launching the unit.

Verifies the current propensity acceptance and model plus the six registered data/cache identities; enforces parent cgroup headroom, empty campaign descendants, selected-GPU identity/free-memory reserve, physical scratch, and exact worker limits.

Preserves the fixed train+valid scope with held-out validation excluded, three epochs and fixed epoch-2 checkpoint, no evaluation during fit, strict FP32 Muon, and the reviewed seed/name; no profile-only flags enter the fit command.

Uses the accepted profile command only as the systemd prefix template, changes the unit/output paths and runtime limit, then invokes the pinned canonical training entry point with the fixed fit arguments.
limitations: The profile acceptance is engineering feasibility evidence only; it records 120 finite FP32 updates and memory peaks, not a checkpoint or quality result.
This artifact reviews the admission logic only. It does not attest that the full fit has been admitted or completed.
validation_provenance: Independent static review of current helper, binding, profile acceptance/launch, and reused guard hashes. Root reported compile and Ruff checks pass; not rerun in this review.
